text:
incident-bot: PAGE: cont-batcher-usw2 p99 latency 1.8s (> SLO 1.0s) - paging eng-sre - alerts: streaming_tail,p99_spike - ticket: INC-4721

alice: got it paging in. grabbing logs + first-touch.

ben: observed p99 spike correlated with high mixlen ratio on host gpu-pool-7. KV eviction up ~3x.

carlos: can someone dump batcher metrics? seqlen distribution, batch sizes, preempt counts.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: For cont-batcher tail latency -> try reducing max_batch_size, enable preemptive_shed=true, and toggle per-queue fairness. See /runbooks/contbatch-tail

dana: I can flip max_batch_size to 16 on the canary pool. Want me to do it?

alice: yes flip on canary and watch p95/p99 for 5m. Also enable hedging=50ms for streaming requests.

ben: adding note: heatmap shows 90th percentile input length 3 tokens, 1% > 1024 causing large KV maintenance. Mixedseqs are amplifying pack sizes.

carlos: done: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/configs/batcher/canary -d '{"max_batch_size":16,"preemptive_shed":true,"stream_hedge_ms":50}'` -> 200 OK

dana: metrics: p95 down from 600ms -> 420ms, p99 from 1.8s -> 1.1s after canary change. Still flirting with SLO.

alice: good. let's also pin fallback to smaller model variant for streaming when seq_len>512 to avoid kv pressure. Ben, can you prepare a routing rule?

ben: routing rule drafted, pushing to canary: `if seq_len > 512 -> model=redwood-small-quant`

sre-runbook-bot: Reminder: escalate to oncall-eng-runtime if p99 > 1.5s for >2 consecutive mins.

carlos: KV churn dropped after batch cap. Eviction rate down 70%. CPU on packer reduced.

alice: planning handoff in 10m to night-sre. I'll write summary + actions.

alice: summary: root cause = mixed-seq snowballing packing large long requests into big batches causing KV churn and preemption delays. Mitigations applied: max_batch_size=16, preemptive_shed=true, stream_hedge=50ms, routing for >512 seq->small-model. Monitor for 30m. If p99 >1.5s re-open page.

dana: :thumbsup: I'll keep live watch on grafana and forward alerts to night-sre.

ben: :memo: logged changes to INC-4721 and committed patch to infra-configs repo.
